n7ce5400882.headline: Zim’s Wealthy Rudland Family Set To Take Over Tongaat Hulett
n7ce5400882.summary: The Rudland family is poised to take control of Tongaat Hulett, a major South African sugar producer, by underwriting a $257 million rights issue through their Mauritius-registered company Magister.
n7ce5400882.why: Tongaat Hulett is a significant player in the Southern African sugar industry, and a major rights issue and ownership change can impact the company’s financial health and market position.
